app.title: Ninnies Solitaire
spider.name: Spider
spider.blurb: Build runs from King to Ace in a single suit.
spider.timeToDeal: Time to deal a new row
hearts.name: Hearts
hearts.blurb: Dodge the hearts and the Q♠ against 🦊 Fox, 🦉 Owl and 🐻 Bear.
hearts.noPointsFirst: No points on the first trick
spite.name: Spite & Malice
spite.blurb: Race to empty your goal pile. Build 1 to 12; ★ is wild.
spite.status: Spite & Malice · goal cards left: you {mine}, {foe} {theirs}
spite.pickFirst: Pick a card from your hand first
spite.playOrDiscard: Play it, or drop it on a pile below to end your turn
freecell.name: FreeCell
freecell.blurb: Every card face up. Four free cells to plan your way home.
freecell.sub: Nearly every deal can be won
freecell.setupLine: Every card face up: plan your way home
freecell.noWin: No winning way from here: try Undo
freecell.altRunOnly: Only an alternating-colour run moves together
freecell.notEnoughCells: Not enough free cells to move that many
tapToReturn: Tap to return to your game
settings.title: Settings
settings.lookSub: Cards, court cards, card back, table
settings.saved: Your game is saved on this device automatically.
opt.noMovesAlert.hint: Only when nothing can be moved or dealt; use Hint otherwise
opt.tapToMove.hint: Double-tap a card to send it to the best spot
opt.singleTap.hint: Move with one tap instead of two
opt.dimLocked.hint: Only the movable run in each column stays bright white
opt.dealWithEmpty.hint: Off follows the classic rule: fill every column before dealing
opt.showTargets.hint: Highlights legal drop spots while dragging
opt.heartsPassing.hint: Swap 3 cards before each hand (left, right, across, none)
opt.heartsOneTap.hint: Off: tap to lift a card, tap again to play it
opt.dimLockedHearts.hint: On your turn, only playable cards stay bright
opt.heartsShort.hint: Play to 50 points instead of 100 (from the next game)
opt.heartsMoonSubtract.hint: Shooting the moon takes 26 off your score instead of adding 26 to everyone else
opt.heartsFast.hint: Fox, Owl and Bear play faster
opt.spiteShort.hint: 13-card goal piles instead of 20 (from the next game)
opt.fourColour.hint: Blue diamonds and green clubs, so no two suits share a colour
opt.bunny.hint: Cheers you on with gestures; tap it for a hint
stuck.title: Out of moves
stuck.text: Nothing on the table can be moved and there are no cards left to deal.
bunny.aria: Hint Bunny: tap for a hint
card.name: {rank} of {suit}
landscaper.name: Landscaper
landscaper.blurb: Lay tiles to grow roads, cities and fields, and claim them with your followers.
landscaper.pickSpot: Tap a glowing square to lay your tile
landscaper.turnOrPlace: Tap it again to turn it, then place it
landscaper.pickFollower: Tap a spot for a follower, or carry on
opt.landscaperFarmers.hint: Followers can lie in fields; at the end they score 3 for each finished city their field borders
opt.landscaperRiver.hint: Start with the river: it winds out from its spring to a lake before the rest of the map grows
landscaper.about.builder: Grows big cities and long roads.
landscaper.about.saboteur: Out to spoil everyone else's plans.
landscaper.about.longGame: Farms and cloisters, followers saved for later.
landscaper.about.opportunist: Grabs whatever points are going right now.
landscaper.lineupTip: Tap an opponent to change how they play, or their level to change how strong they are.
